articles.summary: The RealReal (Nasdaq: REAL), the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated resale luxury goods, today announced the appointment of Alexis Hoopes as Chief Merchandising Officer. Hoopes joins from eBay, where she led the company's $10 billion global fashion business, bringing extensive experience in luxury merchandising, international marketplace expansion and digital commerce from leadership roles at eBay, Mattel and Nordstrom. In her new role, Hoopes will lead The RealReal's merchandising strategy, with a focus on strengthening its luxury assortment, enhancing personalized product discovery and unlocking new opportunities for growth through technology, data and global marketplace expertise. "Alexis is a proven leader who brings a rare combination of luxury merchandising expertise, global marketplace experience and operational discipline," said Rati Sahi Levesque, President and CEO of The RealReal. articles.summary: Refinancing Extends Secured Debt Maturity to 2033 and Reduces Interest Expense Outlines Medium-Term Target for Leverage The RealReal, Inc. (Nasdaq: REAL) (the "Company"), the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, today announced that it has entered into a credit agreement providing for a new $150 million senior secured term loan and a new $25 million senior secured revolving credit facility (collectively, the "New Credit Facilities"). The Company intends to use the proceeds of the term loan to redeem all of its outstanding 4.25%/8.75% PIK/Cash Pay Senior Secured Notes due 2029 (the "2029 Notes") at par. Funding of the term loan and redemption of the 2029 Notes are expected to occur on or about October 19, 2026. Funds managed by affiliates of Fortress Investment Group LLC ("Fortress") will fund the New Credit Facilities, which initially bear interest at SOFR plus 5.75%, subject to a leverage-based pricing mechanism, payable entirely in cash. articles.summary: The RealReal, Inc. (Nasdaq: REAL)—the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods—today reported financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third quarter 2026 gross merchandise value (GMV) and total revenue increased 23% and 19% compared to the third quarter of 2025, respectively. Consignment revenue grew 18% compared to the prior year period, and Direct Revenue grew 19% year-over-year in the third quarter. During the quarter, gross margin of 74.9% improved 64 basis points compared to the same period in 2025. Third quarter Adjusted EBITDA margin was 8.3%, an increase of 290 basis points versus the prior year period. "Q3 was another record quarter for The RealReal, with quarterly all-time highs in GMV, revenue and orders, with our strongest quarterly order growth since 2022, up 15% versus last year," said Rati Levesque, CEO of The RealReal. The RealReal will host a conference call at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. Eastern Time) to review its financial results. A live webcast of the conference call will be available online at investor.therealreal.com . The archived webcast will be available shortly after the call at the same location.
